verdict.rationale: There are only indirect multi-item capabilities. search_catalog accepts a set of product IDs and lookup_catalog resolves known IDs and URLs in one call. Results paginate up to 1,000 per query, and create_checkout inherits a cart's full set of line_items. There is no documented bulk or batch mutation tooling, and the cross-merchant Universal Cart is waitlisted. Missing for 10: explicit bulk or batch operation APIs (e.g. multi-cart or multi-order actions), documented batch limits, and hands-on evidence of multi-item operations at scale.
